Dear Eolis Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Content Creator / Storyteller position at Eolis, as advertised. My background as a Digital Marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, content, and web aligns well with your mission to bring brand stories to life and simplify complex topics.

My experience creating compelling content, combined with my proficiency in AI tools and technical SEO, enables me to craft clear and impactful narratives across various platforms.

I am eager to contribute my blend of strategic thinking and hands-on creation to your team. Please find my detailed CV attached for your review.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Eolis Hiring Team,

I am writing with great enthusiasm to express my interest in the Content Creator / Storyteller position at Eolis. Your approach to helping brands find and animate their stories across varied industries, from tech scale-ups to corporate organizations, deeply resonates with my professional journey as a Digital Marketer who combines technical expertise with creative content development.

Throughout my experience, particularly as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto and Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I have consistently balanced strategic thinking with hands-on content creation. I’ve translated brand objectives into compelling online experiences, from crafting SEO-optimized blog content for e-commerce and consultancy clients to building and maintaining comprehensive websites for a pharmacists’ association. My background includes not only writing content that ranks, but also designing site structures and integrating social media, always aiming to make complex information clear and engaging. My recent HubSpot Content Marketing Certification further solidifies this focus.

I thrive on taking ownership of projects and enjoy the process of diving into new topics to uncover their unique narratives. For instance, I implemented JSON-LD schema and knowledge-graph markup for mirook.com, turning technical SEO elements into structured stories for search engines. I am also adept at leveraging content analytics with tools like Google Analytics and Semrush to measure performance and iteratively refine content for maximum impact and engagement. My daily use of AI tools for content research and prompt engineering underscores my interest in exploring new formats and staying ahead of digital trends.

The opportunity to contribute to a dynamic team where creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement are valued is particularly exciting. I am confident that my blend of technical acumen, data-driven approach, and passion for crafting compelling digital stories would be a valuable asset to Eolis.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and experience can support Eolis's mission.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Crafted SEO-optimized blog and website content, managing diverse client platforms (e-commerce, consultancy, pharmacists' association).
- Expert in simplifying complex topics, from technical SEO schemas (JSON-LD) to structured content for specialized industries.
- Applied content analytics (Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush) to track performance and iteratively improve content strategies.
- Designed and built comprehensive websites, including content and social media integration, demonstrating hands-on content delivery.
- Utilized AI/LLMs for content research and automation, coupled with a technical background to understand digital culture and emerging formats.
